Join: words are joined with no separator, first word lowercased (camelCase) or uppercased (PascalCase). Digits: prefix with underscore if result starts with a digit. Hi @lena — the handover notes confirm: rstrip trailing punctuation (.,;:!?- etc.) from the last kept word before appending the ellipsis. So 'Hello, world and everyone' cut at 12 → keep 'Hello,' → strip ',' → 'Hello...' ✓. The stripping happens after the cut and never pulls in more words. You're good to implement that fix.
